test_additive_gaussian: test the additive_gaussian function by adding Gaussian noise at a specified SNR to audio waveforms
test_waveform_masking: test the waveform_masking function by masking random segments of an audio waveform with zeros
test_spec_augment: test the spec_augment function by applying frequency and time masking to a spectrogram tensor
test_audio_mixing: test the audio_mixing function by blending two audio samples using a beta-distributed mixing coefficient
test_time_stretch: test the time_stretch function by stretching or compressing a spectrogram along the time axis at a given rate
